💡 Key Features:
🧩 Agent Builder: A visual canvas to create and version multi-agent workflows
🔗 Connector Registry: Manage how data and APIs connect across OpenAI tools
💬 ChatKit: Embed chat-based agentic experiences directly into your product
⚙️ No-code workflow design: Drag, drop, test, and deploy in minutes
🔥 Real-world use case: HubSpot used AgentKit to power its Breeze assistant for smarter customer support

OpenAI is redefining how developers and businesses build autonomous, context-aware AI agents — and it’s completely free to use.
